label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.step(1); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: document.getElementById('title').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })

label: 1P overlaps
js: (() => { document.body.classList.add('touch'); game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true, players: 1 }); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 4, 2); game.step(2); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: 2P overlaps
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true, players: 2 }); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 4, 2); game.put(1, 3, 1); game.step(2); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: results
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, go: true }); const W = game.world(); WC.sim.loadBuilding(W, 3); W.phase = 'play'; game.quiet(); game.put(0, W.towers[0].L.rows - 1, 2); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.9); k('ArrowUp', 0); game.step(5.5); return JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 }); })()
